subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram slash sessions still resolve to channel=(unknown), causing elevated allowFrom checks to fail on 2026.3.13

question: Should maintainers adopt one of the open fork fixes, or sponsor a replacement that combines raw-key scoping and static channel fallback for Telegram slash elevated diagnostics?
rationale: The current source confirms the bug, but the existing same-repo attempts were closed as partial/stale and the change affects elevated host-exec authorization diagnostics.

options.title: Sponsor combined replacement
options.body: Create or adopt one narrow PR that combines raw `telegram:slash:*` key scoping with static built-in channel resolution and requires focused tests plus live Telegram proof.

options.title: Refresh a fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author to update the branch, combine the missing half of the fix, and provide real Telegram proof before review.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue open while maintainers defer the elevated host-exec diagnostic boundary decision.

recommendation.title: Sponsor combined replacement
recommendation.body: Create or adopt one narrow PR that combines raw `telegram:slash:*` key scoping with static built-in channel resolution and requires focused tests plus live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The sandbox explain inspector and elevated command history point most strongly to this owner for the repair shape decision.
